note: Per-photo cut-out hints for tools/web/export_photos.py. crop is [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the photo; grabcut segments the garment instead of keying a plain backdrop; drop_light also removes pale, unsaturated pixels (a white sheet the garment lies on). erode shrinks the cut-out by that many pixels (a white outline drawn round the garment). keep_light keeps pale pixels inside [left, top, right, bottom] (a white fur trim).
